advice_items.quote: I started reading Into Thin Air and then it clicked for me what the problem was with my company
advice_items.summary_en: Read books—even outside business—to gain frameworks that help diagnose and solve critical company problems.
advice_items.summary_zh: 通过跨界阅读获取思维框架，解决公司成长危机

advice_items.quote: it was my responsibility to stop handing them balls and also in some cases take them down the mountain
advice_items.summary_en: During rapid growth, recognize each employee's capacity ceiling and take responsibility as a leader to stop overloading them or move them back to a manageable scope.
advice_items.summary_zh: 识别快速扩张期员工的能力上限，及时减负或回调岗位
